purpose: Home Companion execution and feedback contracts. Scripted provider answers test runtime boundaries; they do not qualify a real model's interpretation of user prompts.

required: provider failure after a received command does not require Repairs
read failure displays one error and creates no recovery issue
ambiguous target produces no control attempt
missing context produces no control attempt and requests a complete request
all conversation styles and detail levels
Voice, Agent Chat and AI Task ingress
mixed-availability room feedback separates confirmed and unavailable targets
invalid read report receives one tools-free formatting correction
live_qualification.gate: Every expected target, forbidden effect and feedback check must pass. Preserve failed runs; do not qualify a model solely from simulated replies or a single successful prompt.
